# Code of Conduct

Harmony Revival follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## In short

- Be respectful and assume good faith. People here are volunteers fixing hardware
  a company stopped supporting.
- No harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, or publishing other
  people's private information. That includes other people's account tokens or
  IDs found in captures.
- Criticise code and ideas, not people.

## Scope

All Harmony Revival spaces: repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions,
and any chat linked from them. It also applies when you represent the project
elsewhere.

## Reporting

Report conduct issues privately to the maintainer. Use the
"Report content" option on the comment, or contact the maintainer via their
[GitHub profile](https://github.com/aleksgain).
Reports are kept confidential.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions, and may warn, temporarily ban or
permanently ban contributors, following the Contributor Covenant's
[enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines).
